                <div class="about-text-box">
                    <span class="sub-title">OUR STORY</span>
                    <h2>Rooted in Purity & Tradition</h2>
                    <p>At <strong>Desi Cow Milk</strong>, our journey began with a simple vision: bringing back the authentic, nutrient-rich dairy experience that our ancestors cherished. In today’s fast-paced world, finding pure and chemical-free milk can be a challenge.</p>
                    <p>We bridge this gap by sourcing fresh A2 milk directly from indigenous desi cows (Gir, Kankrej, Sahiwal) that are nurtured with utmost love, natural fodder, and standard ethical care.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

    <!-- WHY A2 MILK / PROCESS SECTION -->
    <section class="section">
        <div class="container">
            <div class="section-title">
                <h2>How We Ensure Quality</h2>
                <p>From our farms to your doorstep, every single drop undergoes strict quality control.</p>
            </div>

            <div class="process-steps">
                <div class="step">
                    <div class="step-num">01</div>
                    <h3>Healthy Cows</h3>
                    <p>Our cows are fed natural green grass and ayurvedic herbs to keep them healthy without antibiotics or hormone injections.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="step">
                    <div class="step-num">02</div>
                    <h3>Hygienic Milking</h3>
                    <p>Milking is done in clean environments adhering to strict hygiene standards to keep the milk natural and untouched.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="step">
                    <div class="step-num">03</div>
                    <h3>Chilling & Testing</h3>
                    <p>The milk is immediately chilled to 4°C to preserve freshness and natural nutrients without processing or preservatives.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="step">
                    <div class="step-num">04</div>
                    <h3>Fresh Delivery</h3>
                    <p>Delivered fresh to your doorstep within hours of milking so you get maximum taste and natural nutrition.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>
